purpose: Teach: 勝てる/そろえ/置け/絞ら/読み直し/在り方/実装/低減

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合に勝てる戦略を立てろ
lines.en: Develop a strategy that can beat our competitors.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Decisive tone with no softness. Brief pauses between clauses. Delivered without explanation or justification needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。書類をそろえております
lines.en: Yes. The documents are all in order.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Steady delivery with a slight lift at the end—confirming readiness. Professional but not stiff; warm underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資料をきちんと置けるよう棚を増やせ
lines.en: Add more shelving so we can store documents properly.
lines.style: Task-focused directive. Firm but not harsh. Specific and final—no room for interpretation. Delivered as a practical solution, not a complaint.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、新製品ラインを絞らせていただきました
lines.en: Yes. We've narrowed our new product line as requested.
lines.style: Respectful update with quiet pride. Steady pace. Slight emphasis on 'narrowed'—showing the work is complete. Not defensive, just factual.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約書を読み直して報告しろ
lines.en: Read through the contracts again and report back to me.
lines.style: Direct, no-nonsense instruction. Even cadence. Slight hardness on 'read through'—this matters. Expects compliance without question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事業の在り方を見直しております
lines.en: Yes. We're currently reviewing how the business operates.
lines.style: Measured confirmation with understated momentum. Calm, steady tone. Suggests ongoing diligence without overstatement. Respectful deference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新システムを実装しろ
lines.style: Sharp, economical directive. Clipped front. No elaboration needed—he has full confidence in the team. Final and definitive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経費低減を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're working on reducing operational expenses.
lines.style: Closing affirmation with quiet assurance. Steady, even pace. Light finish—no lingering doubt. Professional and controlled to the end.
